csv_project_name: AE for Yampa River Core Trail & C Hole Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Steamboat Springs, hereinafter referred to as the City, is soliciting requests for proposals (RFP) from qualified firms to provide landscape design services for river access improvements and associated recreational amenities at Charlie s Hole (C Hole) on the Yampa River in Steamboat Springs, Colorado, hereinafter referred to as the Project (Exhibit A). The Project s goals include: Improve accessibility and provide additional seating areas to enhance recreational experiences in and around C Hole on the Yampa River Stabilize upland bank areas in the vicinity that are experiencing accelerated erosion due to foot traffic Protect existing structural infrastructure, specifically the Yampa River Core Trail Improve terrestrial habitat through removal of existing vegetation and installation of appropriate, non-irrigated plantings Fit within the context of a holistic, reach-scale approach to stream health identified in the Yampa River Health Assessment and Streamflow Management Plan, while balancing the need to protect infrastructure (trails, river access, and City property)
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics
